lines: Plans change. A member can leave a Popkin they no longer want.
A member who is not the Host opens Popkin settings. Two choices: Invite people, and Leave this Popkin.
Leave Lakeside Weekend? Your messages and photos stay. To come back, you'll need a new invite.
Leave, or Stay. Stay is where the focus starts.
Leave reads Leaving, while it goes through.
Then My Popkins opens, and Lakeside Weekend is gone from it.
Everyone still in it sees one member fewer, straight away. Fourteen members becomes thirteen.
My Popkins uses the width it is given: one column on a phone, and more across as the screen grows.
What no screen shows: the Host has no way to leave, even by hand. And once you have left, everything in the Popkin answers: not found.
If leaving fails, the dialog says so, and you stay.
That is journey eighteen. Popkin is a free platform for pop-up communities.
